<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/v1.0/audits/policies/types"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieves all available asset audit policy types. Policy types define the category or classification of audit policies (e.g., scheduled physical verification, compliance audit, inventory check). This endpoint returns the complete set of policy type definitions available in the system, which can be used when creating or configuring audit policies. The returned types include metadata such as display names, descriptions, and configuration options specific to each policy type.
